candidate.blueprint_locator: Management of Care — Performance Improvement (Quality Improvement), printed p.22 / PDF p.26: participate in performance-improvement projects and quality-improvement processes; evaluate impact on client care and resource use. Management of Care — Continuity of Care: perform safe discharge procedures and follow up unresolved client-care issues
candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — Performance Improvement / readmission reduction and discharge coordination
candidate.educational_objective: Use coordinated discharge communication and patient/caregiver engagement as quality-improvement strategies that align with CMS HRRP efforts to reduce avoidable readmissions.

options.A: Strengthen discharge communication and care coordination and actively engage clients and caregivers in post-discharge plans
options.B: Limit improvement work to elective surgical scheduling because HRRP does not include medical conditions
options.C: Focus on changing billing codes without addressing discharge communication or care coordination
options.D: Reduce follow-up communication after discharge so clients return only if symptoms become severe

candidate.rationale: CMS describes HRRP as a Medicare value-based purchasing program that encourages hospitals to improve communication and care coordination, better engage patients and caregivers in discharge plans, and reduce avoidable readmissions. HRRP includes both medical conditions and procedures. Changing billing documentation alone does not address the program's care-quality goal, and reducing follow-up communication conflicts with coordinated transitional care. Therefore A is the best answer.
candidate.source_claim_supported: HRRP links payment to hospital quality and encourages communication, care coordination, and patient/caregiver engagement in discharge planning to reduce avoidable readmissions.
candidate.source_locator: Sections 'What is the Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program?' and 'Why is the Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program important?': Medicare value-based purchasing program encouraging improved communication and care coordination to engage patients/caregivers in discharge plans and reduce avoidable readmissions; FY 2026 IPPS final-rule fact sheet — HRRP reduces payments to hospitals with excess readmissions and links payment to quality of hospital care
candidate.source_version_date: CMS page last modified 2026-03-10; FY 2026 program confirmed in CMS-1833-F
candidate.stem: A hospital has excess readmissions for conditions included in the CMS Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program (HRRP). Which nursing quality-improvement strategy most directly aligns with the program's stated purpose?
